2126551523727663251.en_summary: Tata Steel offered APL Apollo shareholders a premium this week. The stock fell well below the offer price anyway. The reason is in the structure. Only part of everyone's holding can go into the offer, and the rest stays with a company taking on a lot of new debt. Two companies that aren't even part of the deal, SG Mart and SG Finserve, rallied on Monday and hit their lower circuits by Wednesday. We own SG Mart in Surge India, so we've been watching closely Here's what happened and why: https://www.capitalmind.in/insights/the-tata-deal-nobody-liked
2126551523727663251.zh_summary: Tata Steel 本週向 APL Apollo 股東提供溢價。股價仍然遠低於要約價格。原因在於結構。每個人的持有只有一部分可以進入要約，其餘留在一家承擔大量新債務的公司。甚至不是交易一部分的兩家公司 SG Mart 和 SG Finserve 週一上漲並在週三觸及下限。我們在 Surge India 持有 SG Mart，因此一直密切關注。這是發生了什麼以及為什麼：https://www.capitalmind.in/insights/the-tata-deal-nobody-liked
